changes.comment: IAtomicWriteCapabilities gains an optional reason, populated by the filesystem, in-memory and non-atomic DirectoryItem answers; DirectoryItem.getStorageIdentity (optional on IFileTreeDirectoryItem) names the accessors, path and, via the new optional IFileTreeAccessors.resolveRealPath, the real path of a directory; atomicWriteGuarantees lists every guarantee in order; FsFileTreeAccessors' atomic methods qualify a directory reached through a symbolic link as its target and refuse one whose real path leads outside the tree root
